heading: Other information about the claim
paragraphs: You will now be asked some final questions about your claim, including:
bullets: to provide any other information about your reasons for possession
whether you intend to make a general application with this claim
whether you need any support to use this service or come to court
which language you completed this claim in
afterBullets: You will also be asked if you want to answer optional questions to make sure we’re treating everyone fairly.
You can then review your answers and submit and pay for your claim.
